B025-01.notes: -3^2 = -9 (exponent before negation); (-2)^3 = -8; sum -17. Order-of-operations trap (-1 from treating as +9) catches some.

B025-02.notes: 8^2=64 through 22^2=484 -> 22-8+1 = 15. Off-by-one trap gives 14; 22 distractor is the top root.

B025-03.notes: Initial height sqrt(625-49)=24; final sqrt(625-225)=20; slide 4. Two Pythagorean steps.

B025-05.notes: Area = 1/2*8*10*sin60 = 20*sqrt3. Requires the SAS area formula or drawing an altitude (8 sin60 = 4sqrt3).

B025-06.notes: Sum drops by 36 so mean drops; largest value stays largest, so the middle (4th) value is unchanged -> median unchanged.

B025-07.notes: n(n-3)/2 = 10*7/2 = 35. 45 = C(10,2) trap if sides not subtracted.

B025-09.notes: Adding the equations gives 6x-2y = 28 directly (or x=5, y=1). Solving the system is routine with a calculator; easy-medium border.

B025-10.notes: x^2-4 = 3 -> x=+-sqrt7; x^2-4 = -3 -> x=+-1. Four solutions. Trap: forget the negative case (answer 2).
